name: Municipal solid waste landfilling of polyvinyl chloride, PVC
description:
This process reflects the Landfilling of PVC normalized to the functional unit of 1 short ton of treated waste. 

This process was adapted from WARM v16 zolca format by connecting technosphere flows to USLCI flows where possible and mapping elementary flows to the Federal Elementary Flow List (FEDEFL).

The landfilling system is inclusive of collection, transport, landfilling equipment operation, and credits emissions avoided via landfill gas-to-energy projects. 

Inventory data was compiled using laboratory data and analytical estimates (Barlaz, 1998; De la Cruz and Barlaz, 2010; Levis and Barlaz, 2014). This process represents national average landfill equipment operations.
category: 56: Administrative and Support and Waste Management and Remediation Services/5622: Waste Treatment and Disposal

processDocumentation.timeDescription: Data sources range in temporal scope. The oldest sources are from the 1990s and the newest sources are from the 2010s.
processDocumentation.geographyDescription: National average landfill equipment and transport data. Laboratory data extrapolated to landfill-scale conditions for decomposition estimates.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: This process represents average US landfill under average conditions. Includes collection, transport, and operation of generic landfill equipment.
processDocumentation.modelingConstantsDescription: Data from WARM v16 in openLCA (zolca) format was adapted to be compatible with the Federal LCA Commons. This included mapping the elementary flows to the Federal Elementary Flow List and mapping background technosphere flows (e.g., transport, fuels, and electricity) to existing USLCI flows. More information about the data transformation from WARM is provided here - https://github.com/FLCAC-admin/uslci-content/tree/dev/docs/supporting_docs/WARM.
processDocumentation.completenessDescription:
Treatment of Missing Environmental Data: This process includes an inventory of direct greenhouse gas emissions and economic flows. View the WARM documentation for more details about missing environmental data.

Treatment of Missing Technosphere Data: There are no major gaps in technosphere data. View the WARM documentation for more information.

Mass Balance: Mass balance calculations  for this process are included in the background WARM documentation.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Inventory exchange values were generated based on sources cited in EPA documentation for the WARM model
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: Inventory exchange values were generated based on sources cited in EPA documentation for the WARM model. View the modeling constants field above. More information about the data transformation from WARM is provided here - https://github.com/FLCAC-admin/uslci-content/tree/dev/docs/supporting_docs/WARM.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: The landfilling system is inclusive of collection, transport, landfilling equipment operation, and credits emissions avoided via landfill gas-to-energy prpjects. Inventory exchange values were generated based on sources cited in EPA documentation for the WARM model. Uncertainty is not calculated.

reviews.details: WARM has been externally peer reviewed and this openLCA inventory was reviewed internally.

processDocumentation.intendedApplication: EPA created the Waste Reduction Model to provide high-level comparisons of potential greenhouse gas emissions reductions, energy savings, and economic impacts when considering different materials management practices. WARM exclusively evaluates GHG and economic impacts of waste management pathways, and is intended as a purely descriptive model of the systems under analysis.
